main_text.p: Gehenna eft domus cruciatus, qui durat sine diffipatione[?], seu fine. Hinc quando oratur apud Orientales pro Defunctis, fupplicatur Deus, vt animas eorum eruat a poenis Sciul siue Inferorum: At nunquam a poenis Gehennæ, a quibus nulla est redemptio; etsi oretur, ne mittantur in eam. In quo quidem sensu intelligendum venit illud Ecclesiæ Romanæ in Officio Defunctorum: A porta Inferi erue Domine animas eorum. Demonstrauimus præterea in ipsis notis, suffragia viuorum pro Defunctorum animabus, nihil prodesse Damnatis, & id ex capite 39. Constit. Ecclesiæ Maronitarum, & Melchitarum, cap. 22. Cophtitarum, & cap. 5. sect. 1. Iacobitarum; vbi verba referuntur traditionis Apostolicæ, ac inter cætera dicitur: Et sane credimus, id fieri pro illis, qui præditi sunt continentia, fide, & iustitia, nam pro maiorum (criminum) patratoribus, & Infidelibus, etsi in eleemosynam erogaretur quicquid in hoc mundo bonorum est, nihil illis proderit. Hanc eandem traditionem Apostolicam sub Iacobi nomine totidem, ac numeratis verbis refert Hebedie-su libro supra laudato, titulo [illegible, ~6 letters]

page.notes: The top line (running head) and the final word of the page are in Arabic script and could not be read; the foot-left Arabic line is outside the text block and was not transcribed. "Sciul" and the first-line word "sine" are doubtful; "fine" may be read differently. Hebediesu is a line-end break with a printed hyphen, kept as printed. The page has no marginal notes.
